decisions.reason: It builds on the firm's existing biomass-to-nutrient knowledge, and in-house R&D with research cooperation supports learning and improvement.
The modular waste-to-energy extensions are directly related to established technologies, so the firm can interpret early results and refine the line.
The waste-oil-to-energy flagship is core to the firm's established offer and benefits from accumulated related knowledge and R&D partnerships.
The plastic-waste-to-fuel flagship is close to existing waste-conversion capabilities, making it likely the firm continues to learn and keep it.
